canonical_pattern: Developing probabilistic programming language with exact inference for loops — Performance was too abysmal to be practical, preventing publicizing of working prototype for years

Email service providers automatically send notifications and receipts to customers using standardized 'no-reply@' sender addresses — Organizations unknowingly expose customer PII, account details, and transaction data to unintended third-party recipients through typos in no-reply addresses

Operating public bug tracking infrastructure under load from automated scrapers — AI bot scrapers consuming enough resources to force complete service shutdown, blocking legitimate developer access to critical bug tracking
Building and deploying LLM-based applications — High inference costs make LLM features economically unviable or require constant optimization, constraining what can be built and deployed

Manufacturing and delivering water bomber aircraft to meet wildfire season demand — Global demand for water bombers exceeds production capacity - customers need aircraft faster than manufacturing timelines allow
Coordinating work across multiple concurrent Claude Code sessions — Context switching and manual information transfer between separate AI coding sessions breaks flow and loses state
Developer wants to build hardware projects after seeing examples on Reddit — Gap between seeing inspiring hardware projects and having hands-on reference implementations to learn from
Installing and running legacy CD-ROM software on modern operating systems — Legacy software (1998 CD-ROM) requires technical workarounds to function on modern OS (Windows 11) - 23 year gap

Coordinating grid power supply adjustments to compensate for predictable temporary solar generation drops during solar eclipses — Predictable astronomical events create planned capacity drops requiring manual coordination across multiple grids and backup power sources
Newspaper typesetting and printing — All specialized knowledge acquired over 26 years becoming obsolete, replaced by computer automation

Developing distributed systems with static safety guarantees — Rust's type system provides memory safety but does not prevent distributed deadlocks, cross-service correctness issues, or protocol mismatches
CPU performance optimization and assembly code review — Performance degradation from suboptimal compiler output requires manual assembly inspection and optimization
SAT solver optimization — General-purpose SAT solvers are suboptimal for domain-specific problems; expertise required to tune solvers for specific problem classes
Engineering team self-assessment through cross-team interviewing — Cannot determine if workflow problems originate from own team or are organization-wide without external comparison

Scientific researchers profile and optimize data processing code for simulation outputs — Grad student spent months building processing tool that takes an hour to run; performance debugging capability exists in standard toolchain but unknown to domain experts
Risk analysis and compliance documentation — Need to support multiple risk analysis methodologies simultaneously with different formats and requirements

Using AI coding tools to generate code within existing software projects — AI tools lack persistent memory of project-specific context, requiring repeated manual context provision for every coding task
Managing multiple AI coding agents simultaneously within terminal multiplexer environments — Developers need to manually orchestrate and track multiple AI coding agents across terminal sessions

Geographic arbitrage decision-making for remote workers with cross-border residency requirements — Decision paralysis from comparing incommensurable factors (family proximity, residency activation requirements, property investment, marriage prospects) across three countries without clear optimization framework

Installing apps from alternative sources (F-Droid, sideloading) on Android devices — Banking apps and apps requiring Play Integrity refuse to work without Google Play Services. Installing unverified packages requires: clicking build number 7 times, enabling special setting, entering device PIN, then mandatory 24-hour wait
Software developers managing AI inference costs — Cannot predict or control inference costs before bills arrive; no feedback loop between prompt design and actual token/cost impact

Manufacturing and delivering Canadair water bomber aircraft to global customers — Global demand for water bombers exceeds manufacturing capacity; customers face multi-year wait times for aircraft delivery amid increasing wildfire frequency
Hot metal typesetting knowledge transfer from human craftspeople to computerized systems — Complete skillset obsolescence as domain knowledge gets transferred to and locked inside computer systems

Building distributed systems with compile-time safety guarantees — Rust type system prevents memory safety issues but provides no guarantees against distributed deadlocks, cross-service correctness problems, or protocol mismatches between independent nodes
CPU performance benchmarking and optimization — Time spent optimizing code based on benchmarks that don't reflect actual production performance characteristics
SAT solver optimization through domain-specific code generation — Generic SAT solvers waste computation on irrelevant branches and checks for specific problem domains
Developer self-assessment during difficult team dynamics — Uncertainty about whether one is source of team dysfunction vs victim of dysfunctional team environment

Scientific computing grad students processing large simulation outputs (200GB-TB scale) to construct analysis trees — Hour-long processing runs on 200GB data; repeated file reads; inefficient nested dictionary structures simulating trees; difficulty understanding own code
Payment payout processing with timeout handling — Timeout errors misinterpreted as failures, risking duplicate payouts or requiring manual status verification

Writing and distributing postmortem incident reports after production defects — Each incident investigation requires custom writeup effort; format and completeness varies; knowledge of 'how it was invisible' and 'how it was found' must be deliberately captured
Deploying changes to disable or modify AI features in production — Cannot immediately disable problematic AI features without going through full deployment process
